data.description: Immediately upon completion of the spell, and once per round thereafter, you may call down a 5-foot-wide, 30-footlong, vertical bolt of lightning that deals 3d6 points of electricity damage. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a spell's range [measured from your position at the time]. Any creature in the target square or in the path of the bolt is affected. You need not call a bolt of lightning immediately; other actions, even spellcasting, can be performed first. Each round after the first you may use a standard action [concentrating on the spell] to call a bolt. You may call a total number of bolts equal to your caster level [maximum 10 bolts]. If you are outdoors and in a stormy area-a rain shower, clouds and wind, hot and cloudy conditions, or even a tornado [including a whirlwind formed by a djinni or an air elemental of at least Large size]-each bolt deals 3d10 points of electricity damage instead of 3d6. This spell functions indoors or underground but not underwater.
